notes: All configurations remain candidates for the exact OpenCode harness until they pass compatibility admission.
Public evidence from another harness supports candidacy but does not qualify an OpenCode configuration.
Configured does not mean currently available; the Runner must perform live provider preflight.
Automatic routes prefer capable OpenCode Go configurations, then admit Zen-only models when no Go configuration meets the requested capability, risk, or context.
The console's Use balance option continues the same Go request against Zen credits after Go usage limits are reached; this is not a model-selection fallback.
The runtime never switches models because of quota or provider failure. An exhausted Zen balance stops the run with ZEN_BALANCE_EXHAUSTED.
